subject: ACK: ycbcr_decode.h <string.h> already removed (5629b322: builtins only); EDIT NOTICE render_pipeline.inc generic attachment format read (1 line) + render_encoder.inc XR private allocation
body: 1) ycbcr_decode.h no longer includes <string.h> (uses __builtin_memcpy); render_encoder strcmp -> __builtin_strcmp; build_tegu_frontend_objects.sh ARM64 PASS after that. 2) Next small edit in render_pipeline.inc generic pipeline creation loop (line ~2253 'NSUInteger fmt=(rt<8)?diagnosticFormats[rt]:0'): Apple XR colour formats 552-555 are compiled as RGBA16F (115) attachments (the frontend's XR textures are RGBA16F internally and encode to XR on IOSurface write-back) - diagnostics keep the requested format. 3) render_encoder.inc newTextureWithDescriptor: private (0x20/0x30) XR textures 552-555 allocate as internal RGBA16F with apiFormat=XR (no CPU access exists for private storage). Your uncommitted render_pipeline.inc/nord2_render_pass.inc hunks are untouched; I re-read before editing.
